notes.title: Demo v1.2 | Enemy Updates & More Languages Added | DEN-DEN: TOKYO HORROR
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45121180/5ecf35abf530e940686073b2e7f1177d1ceb8174.png[/img]

Demo version 1.2 is now LIVE!

Today we have released a large update to the demo version of Den-Den: Tokyo Horror. This update includes major updates to the monster enemy AI, support for more languages, and a bunch of other fixes and improvements.

Here is a full list of the updates we have made in this update:

[h1]Version 1.2 Patch Notes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Major changes to enemy AI behavior.
[*] Support for 5 new languages: Spanish (Spain), Spanish (Latin America), Portuguese (Brazil), French and Italian
[*] Added in ability to split ammo stacks.
[*] Removed ability to reload weapons from the ammo context menu due to some issues with the current implementation of this feature. This will be fixed and reimplemented in the future.
[*] Updated visual enhancements to some of the core UI components.
[*] Updates to the overall world lighting of the demo with adjusts to local exposure and color tones. The changes we have made will improve overall visibility for players, reducing eye strain.
[*] Fixed issue where when players would respawn after death, their ability to use Status Condition Buffs would become corrupted.
[*] Status Conditions now use the standardized tooltip, and in addition now have the correct translations when the tooltip is active.
[*] Status Conditions can now be viewed on the HUD when opening an inventory container object.
[*] Fixed an issue where swapping a stackable item with a non-stackable item in your inventory slots would create a visual bug where the non-stackable item would have a quantity value associated with it until it was moved to another slot.
[*] Fixed an issue where swapping a weapon with a non-weapon item in your inventory would create a visual bug where the durability bar of the weapon would be duplicated on the non-weapon until it was moved to another slot.
[*] Increased health bonus for Bandages from 80HP to 100HP.
[*] Increased health bonus from the “Omamori of the Bear” item from 20HP to 50HP.
[/list]


[h1]What's coming next?[/h1]
Our next update will include translation for the following languages:
[list]
[*] Polish
[*] Ukrainian
[*] Vietnamese
[*] Thai
[*] Indonesian
[/list]

In addition to the new language options available to all players, we will continue to work on bug fixes and improvements to the overall experience as we read your survey feedback and watch your videos on YouTube.

Sincerely,
Frozen Lake Software Dev Team

notes.title: Water Delivery - Major Game Update - v1.1 NOW LIVE
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45121180/29d8aab7dec9f9120f6898fe537d970a816c076f.png[/img]

Greetings fellow Water Delivery personnel from the development team over here at Frozen Lake Software! 

We hope you all had a great new year's celebration, and we wish you all the best here in 2025!

As we continue to develop our next upcoming game, we wanted to go back to Water Delivery and make some major updates to the game for a number of reasons. This 1.1 update comes with a bunch of new things and improvements. These changes include things such as updated language support options, updated the game engine to the latest version, a host of new optimizations to improve performance for all players across all types of PC configurations, and lots of bug fixes.

This update comes with a number of performance improvements for the game. We have found that on some lower end machines, we have seen an over 200% increase in performance in certain sections of the game, with a massive decrease in stuttering for players on low-end hardware.

Below you will find the official list of updates to the game. Take care everyone, and we hope you enjoy these latest updates to Water Delivery. Stay tuned for the announcement of our upcoming horror game.

[list]
[*] Added support for five new languages into the game: [b]Polish[/b], [b]Turkish[/b], [b]Ukrainian[/b], [b]Vietnamese[/b], and [b]Indonesian[/b].
[*] Upgraded game engine from Unreal Engine 5.4.4 to Unreal Engine 5.5.1
[*] Replaced the existing LOD system with Nanite, which drastically improved performance for some low-end machines.
[*] Reduced complexity and made improvements on the sky atmosphere, global illumination and weather systems to improve overall performance.
[*] Increased ambient lighting in some areas of the game so that it wouldn't be pitch black.
[*] Updated the navigation system for AI controlled enemies to improve system performance, as well as improve the pathing algorithm so that AI wouldn't get stuck in awkward places and positions as they did in the original version.
[*] In addition to the above updates, we have a lot of the gameplay related bugs that were reported by players, streamers and our internal development team.
[/list]

notes.content: Some users were experiencing issues with screen flickering. To help avoid this issue, I have defaulted the game to 60 FPS cap instead of being defaulted to Unlimited. Users can still change their FPS in the settings menu.
